text:
June: Alert: someone placed a tiny ceramic scone on the middle desk with a Post-it: "Scone Succession Ceremony at noon. All are invited." :scone:
Harper: I saw it. Is this the return of the Pastry Protocol? I brought a tiny napkin flag.
Owen: I nominate we create three roles: Scone Regent (guardian), Crumb Auditor (documents crumbs), and Pastry Chaplain (performs blessing). Short terms, high honor. React with :one: :two: :three: to pick a role to volunteer.
Marta: Also rule proposal: if you take the ceremonial scone, you must replace with equal or greater pastry or recite a haiku. No exceptions.
June: KitchenBot, can you set a reminder: "Scone Succession at 12:00" and ping #random?
KitchenBot: Reminder created: "Scone Succession Ceremony"  Today 12:00  Channel: #random.
Harper: Quick haiku for the ceremony: "Crumbs map morning maps / A quiet crown of butter / Office hearts convene." :sparkles:
Owen: Poll results: Scone Regent (3 volunteers), Crumb Auditor (1), Pastry Chaplain (2). Looks like Scone Regent race is strong. June, are you in?
June: I'll take Regent duties this sprint. Responsibilities: protect scone, enforce haiku rule, and manage succession log. Also I accept bribes in the form of jam.
Marta: Noted. I'll be Crumb Auditor because my detective skills are unparalleled. Also I will bring a tiny magnifying glass.
Harper: Ceremony notes: 12:00 quick photo, one-liner from Regent, haiku reading, ceremonial nibble (tiny only). Afterwards add photo to #random-lore album.
June: Also reminder: if you leave unknown pastries, label them. Mystery danishes resulted in a tiny mold incident last month. We learned things.
Owen: Closing: bless the scone. If anyone has a tiny crown we can borrow, now is the time. Otherwise I'll craft one from sticky notes.
Marta: I'll bring the magnifying glass and a sticker that says "Crumb Certified." See you at noon.
KitchenBot: Reminder triggered: "Scone Succession Ceremony" now.
